title: perf(canary): enhanced auto-detection for KV hysteresis and latency/throughput rollout guards
author: Aisha Martinez
description: Motivation: we continue to see transient canary flaps and false-positive regressions when KV cache behavior changes under load. This PR improves the performance-canary auto-detection pipeline by integrating KV-cache-aware hysteresis into thresholding logic and adding multi-signal detection (latency P95/P99 + throughput + KV hit-rate) to reduce noisy rollouts. Changes: 1) introduce an adaptive EWMA baseline per-route that weights recent samples but decays when load drops; 2) add KV-cache-hit-rate as a first-class signal to the detector and use it to gate sensitivity (lower sensitivity when KV hits fall); 3) implement hysteresis windows around both latency and KV thresholds to avoid flip-flopping during brief spikes; 4) extend the canary config model to include kv_hysteresis_ms, min_kv_hitrate, and adaptive_sensitivity coefficients; 5) update the rollout guard evaluator to require at-least-two-signal confirmation (e.g., latency regression + throughput drop OR latency regression + KV-hit drop) before triggering automatic rollback; 6) add a synthetic load test harness and new integration tests to validate behavior under KV-thrash and cold-cache scenarios; 7) expose two new metrics and alerts in the console: perf_canary.kv_hit_rate and perf_canary.adaptive_sensitivity_active. Testing: unit tests for detector math and hysteresis state machine; e2e perf-canary canary-run simulation that replays historical traces (included) to assert no false positive rollbacks for representative workloads; CI run includes synthetic load job and the standard test matrix against linux-x86_64 and nvidia-a100 runners. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind perf_canary.v2, staged rollout to 10% of canaries for 48h, increase to 50% if no regressions, full rollout after 7 days. Backout: immediate feature-flag revert and manual rollback path described in docs. Related work: builds on ENG-3245 (auto-detection baseline refactor) and ENG-7611 (canary rollout guard API). Checklist: [x] design doc updated; [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] perf harness and replay traces; [x] docs/console schema updated; [x] Linear links added.
